title: Punjab E-Bike Scheme Distribution Date Announced
excerpt: The Punjab government has announced details regarding the distribution of electric bikes to students under a provincial scheme.
body_html:
The provincial government in Punjab has announced plans to provide 100,000 electric bikes to students.

Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif shared the update regarding the initiative, which aims to support students with accessible transportation options through the distribution of electric two-wheelers.
